docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Locke's refutation of the divine right of kings and his account of natural rights, consent and the limits of government.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

John Locke (1632–1704), Two Treatises of Government (1689), in the text of the Hollis edition of 1764. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from the Internet Archive. Modified: converted to this format.
